ad_library.summary: Ecolt Energy is running 2 live Telugu ads on Meta - both sharing one creative (Library ID 1405421181747986, started 13 October 2026) selling a 3KW rooftop system at Rs.1,90,000 with a Rs.33,000 discount plus the Rs.78,000 PM Surya Ghar subsidy - and every click lands in a Facebook lead form, never on the polished ecoltenergy.com the ad budget pays for. The site itself is strong on the basics: SSL, contact form, WhatsApp, an 'Ask Ecolt' chat panel, full meta tags, Open Graph, LocalBusiness schema and an 18-page sitemap with a Telugu version - but it carries zero tracking. No Meta Pixel, no Google Ads tag, no GA4, no GTM: nothing a visitor does on the site can be measured, attributed or retargeted, and the claim of '2,000+ systems installed' sits above counters that read 0 and a project map your own source code labels 'placeholder EXAMPLES only'. No Google Ads record exists for the company, so search demand goes to competitors instead.
